name: Villahermosa del Campo (Spain)
description: Blue field with green wavy-edged panels along the upper and lower edges edged yellow, charged with a yellow palm at the top and a yellow sword at the bottom.
history: Municipal flag of Villahermosa del Campo; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: wavy-edged panels along the upper and lower edges, edged yellow
palm frond on the upper panel
